keyDistinction.runStatus_vs_executionStatus: RunStatus (pending/completed/failed/cancelled) 是 Run 生命周期状态；ExecutionStatus (in-progress/completed/failed/blocked) 是 Action 执行结果。两个值集独立：blocked 不是 RunStatus，cancelled 不是 ExecutionStatus。executionStatus:failed + runStatus:completed 表示 Action 失败但 Run 正常完成；runStatus:failed 表示 Run 自身基础设施失败无 ActionResult。
keyDistinction.ownershipBoundary: B1 拥有逻辑 ActionResult 类型；C1 拥有物理传输 schema RunResultFile 和序列化
